plan.notes: Source: Blinn College District official Welding Technology AAS award plan page ('Course Summary for Welding Technology AAS Degree', CIP 48.0508; blinn.edu/academics/degree-certificates/WeldingAAS.html), the current award plan referenced by the 2024-2025 Catalog Vol. 85. Semester sequence and credit hours transcribed exactly: 15/14/17/14 = 60 credits. Rows whose course-name cell begins with 'or' are alternatives to the preceding course row (one slot), not additional courses — the only reading under which semesters 1, 3 and 4 sum to their declared totals. Semester 4 lists two 4-credit 'Welding Elective' slots with no published option list (transcribed honestly with empty options). The award plan is a suggested sequence. No courses invented.

courses.choice_note: Award plan 'or'-row: 'CNBT 1210 Basic Construction Safety' or 'OSHT 1220 Industrial Safety' (2 cr) — one slot.

Introduction to Blueprint Reading for Welders
